description:
Automatic Windows HDR Switching For Any Application.

PyAutoActions automates HDR management for your games and applications, enabling and disabling HDR based on the process status.
Changes:
- Added Pre-Start and Post-Stop options per process. (Run programs or bat scripts at start and exit using absolute path)
- Added invisible mouse cursor when blocking mouse globally. (Turning it on will requires elevation which will auto prompt user with uac)
- Mouse will be moved to top right corner of the screen.
- Fixed issue when user enters an empty value in one of the settings which ends up removing all process settings.
- Renamed mouse block label.
Notice:
- Starting from PyAutoActions v1.5.0 previous versions need to be uninstalled manually via control panel.
- Future versions will always be unprivileged user installed AppData\Local\Programs instead of previous Program Files folder.
